purpose: Add or repair verification for existing behavior.
negative_examples: review a change without adding verification
work_loop: write a failing or contract-revealing check
run the check and confirm the expected signal
make the check pass without unrelated behavior changes
run proof commands and read the output
done_when: the proof command includes the new check
failure_modes: test checks mocks instead of behavior
test passes before it can fail
fallback_policy: If production behavior must change, switch to implementation or bugfix route.
